heading: Today
text: Areas of valley fog, and some low clouds, especially from the Green Mountains west, giving way to increasing sun this morning, and mostly sunny this afternoon.  Highs in the 40s to near 50 north, 50 to 55 south.  Winds light, becoming southwest less than 10 mph, except south 10 to 15 mph through the Champlain Valley.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear this evening, mixing with a few clouds south, and periods of clouds north.  Lows in the 30s, and cold spots near 30.  Winds light and variable, except south in the Champlain Valley up to 10 mph.

heading: Wednesday
text: Periods of clouds north, some limited sun, and partly sunny south.  Milder.  Highs 50 to 55 north, in the 50s south.  Winds light from the southwest, less than 10 mph, and south near 10 mph in the Champlain Valley.
